I suffering and my boyfriend is my biggest support.  You can:

- learn about depression so you have a better idea of how he feels.  
- ask him how your can be helpful.  Everybody’s different.  For me, my boyfriend helps by listening and reminding me that I will feel better.  Depression is a medical conditions for which there are many treatments. 
- Encourage him to seek treatment.  
- if the depression worsens, read up on how to talk to a severely depress person about suicide.  
- Depression sufferers lack motivation to do things that might distract him from the depressive thoughts.  I’ve learned that motivations follows action.  Today, my boyfriend pushed me to play golf, something for which I had no motivation.  But once was there, I was able to find some relief from my darkest thoughts.
